text:
Although that is the standard dose that many people end up taking, generally doctors don't suggest that you start at that dose.  This drug can have unpleasant side effects (nausea, muscle aches, etc.), so people usually start at a lower, pre-therapeutic (meaning that you're not actually taking enough to make a difference), dose and then very slowly increase over the course of weeks or months so their bodies can adjust.
